title: West Coast Charts options
description: The options object of new WestCoastCharts(el, options), generated from types/*.d.ts. Functions are marked "x-wcc-type": "function" (not expressible in JSON). Premium chart types and their plotOptions need west-coast-charts/premium ("x-wcc-license": "premium").

annotations.description: Lines, ranges, points, texts and images drawn on top of the plot at data coordinates.

licenseKey.description: West Coast Charts premium: licence key of this chart (overrides WestCoastCharts.setLicenseKey)

mode.description: 'auto' (default where on): nothing for labels off the marks, a contrasting text colour over one fill, a pill over mixed fills; 'hide' = skip labels that sit on marks

fallback.description: what 'auto' escalates to over mixed fills or when no text colour reaches minRatio. Default 'pill'

enabled.description: false switches the treatment off for this label kind

contrast.description: swap the text to `light`/`dark` when it misses minRatio against what is under it (any mode)

minRatio.description: WCAG 2 contrast ratio to reach. Default 4.5

light.description: text/backdrop colour pair used by contrast and 'auto' fills. Defaults '#ffffff' / '#111827'

dark.description: Dark colour of the pair. Default: `'#111827'`.

background.description: colour under the chart; 'auto' = chart.background, else the first opaque ancestor

color.description: Outline colour; 'auto' uses the colour under the label or a contrasting one. Default: `'auto'`.

blur.description: Blur in pixels; above 0 the outline becomes a soft glow. Default: `0`.

halo.description: outline behind the glyphs; blur > 0 makes it a soft glow. Defaults width 3, color 'auto' (chart background), opacity 0.92

fill.description: Box colour; 'auto' uses the colour under the label or a contrasting one. Default: `'auto'`.

padding.description: Space around the text in pixels: one number, or [vertical, horizontal]. Default: `[1, 4]`.

stroke.description: Outline colour of the box. Default: `'none'`.

strokeWidth.description: Outline width in pixels. Default: `1`.

offset.description: Shift of the box as [dx, dy] in pixels. Default: `[0, 0]`.

pill.description: backdrop box. padding = [vertical, horizontal]; offset = [dx, dy] px. Defaults fill 'auto', opacity 0.9, radius 4, padding [1, 4]

dx.description: Horizontal shadow offset in pixels. Default: `0`.

dy.description: Vertical shadow offset in pixels. Default: `1`.

color.description: Shadow colour. Default: `'#000000'`.

shadow.description: drop shadow on the pill (on the text in halo mode)

raise.description: axis labels sitting on marks are moved above the series (default true)

each.description: per label: return an override (or 'none') for this one label; called only when set

readability.description: West Coast Charts: default readability of every label kind (dataLabels, axis labels, premium scales)

accessibility.description: West Coast Charts: WCAG 2.2 AA features (all on by default)

width.description:
Chart width: a number is pixels, a string is any CSS length such as a percentage of the
container. Default: `'100%'`.

height.description:
Chart height: a number is pixels, a percentage is relative to the container's height; 'auto'
uses the width divided by 1.61 for axis charts and by 1.2 for the others. Default: `'auto'`.

type.description:
The chart type. The West Coast Charts types (gauge ... calendar) need 'west-coast-charts/types'
(included in 'west-coast-charts/full'), the premium types (sankey ... radialColumn) need
'west-coast-charts/premium'.

foreColor.description:
Text colour used for axis labels, titles and legend text unless their own colour option is set.
Default: `'#373d3f'`.

fontFamily.description:
Font family applied to all chart text that has no own fontFamily. Default: `'Helvetica, Arial,
sans-serif'`.

background.description: Background colour of the chart area; an empty string leaves it transparent. Default: `''`.

offsetX.description: Moves the whole drawing horizontally by this many pixels. Default: `0`.

offsetY.description: Moves the whole drawing vertically by this many pixels. Default: `0`.

enabled.description: Draws the shadow. Default: `false`.

top.description: Vertical shadow distance in pixels. Default: `2`.

left.description: Horizontal shadow distance in pixels. Default: `2`.

nonce.description:
CSP nonce copied onto every `<style>` element the library adds (also in exported SVGs), so a

scheduleChange.description: schedule (layers/schedule): a drag, resize or keyboard move proposes a change `{ id, from, to, conflicts, added, resolved }`; the data is never changed.

scheduleSelect.description: schedule: an appointment or a person was selected (null = cleared).

slotClick.description: schedule: a click on free time `{ time, lane, by, day }`.

scheduleConflict.description: schedule: emitted once per render when the plan has conflicts (the conflicts() list).

taskChange.description: Gantt: a task was moved, resized or edited; return `false` to cancel. Premium charts call it as `(event, chart, info)`.

taskCreate.description: Gantt: a task is created; return `false` to cancel. Premium charts call it as `(event, chart, info)`.

taskDelete.description: Gantt: a task is deleted; return `false` to cancel. Premium charts call it as `(event, chart, info)`.

historyChange.description: Gantt: the undo/redo history changed. Premium charts call it as `(event, chart, info)`.

groupToggle.description: Gantt: a group was collapsed or expanded. Premium charts call it as `(event, chart, info)`.

dependencyCreate.description: Gantt: a dependency is created; return `false` to cancel. Premium charts call it as `(event, chart, info)`.

nodeMove.description: Sankey: a node was dragged. Premium charts call it as `(event, chart, info)`.

childrenLoad.description: Tree: lazily loaded children arrived. Premium charts call it as `(event, chart, info)`.

drawingChange.description: Stock: a drawing was added, changed or removed. Premium charts call it as `(event, chart, info)`.

wccHistoryChange.description: history feature: the undo/redo position changed, `(chart, { index, size, canUndo, canRedo })`.

orient.description:
Orient feature ("Ansicht ausrichten"): turn radialColumn (with all its layers), chord, pie,
donut, polarArea and radialBar charts; `true` = `{ enabled: true }`.

deterministic.description:
Deterministic rendering (agents, CLI, snapshot tests): no animation (the final frame only), no
wall clock (see `now`), a seeded PRNG and stable ids, so the same options give byte-identical
SVG in the same engine. On by itself in headless mode (`WestCoastCharts.headless = true` or
`globalThis.WCC_HEADLESS = true`) unless set to `false`. Several deterministic charts on one
page need distinct `chart.id`s (or seeds). Default: `false`.

seed.description: Seed of the PRNG used for ids and random layouts. Default: a hash of `chart.id`.

now.description:
The current time as the chart sees it ("today" in Gantt): ms since the epoch, a Date, a date
string or a function returning one of those. In deterministic mode without it there is no
clock (no today marker). Default: `Date.now()`.

(console.warn, once per chart), `'error'` also makes `render()` reject, `'off'` skips the
check. Without the module nothing is checked. Default: `'warn'`.

projection.description: Projection; `'auto'` uses the map's own projection hint or `'equalEarth'`. Default: `'auto'`.

by.description: Denominator: a key of the data item or of the region's properties, or `(item, { feature }) => number`; not set: no normalisation.

per.description: Multiplier of the ratio (e.g. `100000` for "per 100k"). Default: `1`.

label.description: Tooltip label of the raw total next to the normalised value. Default: `'Total'`.

normalize.description: Per-unit choropleth values: value / `by` * `per` (e.g. per capita).

exclude.description: Region ids or names left out of the map (case-insensitive). Default: `['ATA']`.

style.description:
Region drawing: `'fill'` (shapes), `'dots'` (a dot grid clipped to the land) or `'tiles'` (one
equal tile per region). Default: `'fill'`.

spacing.description: Distance between dot centres in px (at least 3). Default: `7`.

size.description: Dot diameter as a fraction of the spacing (0.2 to 1). Default: `0.72`.

gap.description: Gap between tiles in px. Default: `2.5`.

labels.description: `false` hides the tile labels; a function `({ id, name, value, properties }) => string` sets them. Default: `true` (region id).

layout.description: Grid placement: a built-in layout name (e.g. `'us-states'`) or `{ id: [col, row] }`; not set uses the built-in layout of the map.

sphere.description:
Draws the globe outline with a faint 30° graticule behind equalEarth and equirectangular maps.
Default: `true`.

type.description:
`'linear'`, `'log'`, `'quantize'` (stepped buckets) or `'diverging'` (around `mid`); a
diverging palette implies `'diverging'`. Default: `'linear'`.

palette.description:
Named palette: blue, green, teal, purple, orange, red, gray, heat, viridis, or diverging
blue-red, green-purple, teal-orange; not set derives a ramp from the theme accent.

colors.description: Own colour stops; win over `palette`.

min.description: Lower end of the scale; not set uses the data minimum.

max.description: Upper end of the scale; not set uses the data maximum.

mid.description: Neutral value of a diverging scale. Default: `0`.

steps.description: Number of buckets of a quantize scale (2 to 12). Default: `5`.

from.description: Lowest value of the range (inclusive); not set: open below.

to.description: Highest value of the range (inclusive); not set: open above.

color.description: Colour of the range; not set takes the next scale colour.

name.description: Legend name of the range.

type.description: Pattern: `'hatch'`, `'hatch-reverse'`, `'cross'`, `'dots'`, `'grid'`, `'vertical'` or `'horizontal'`; other values draw no pattern.

color.description: Ink of the lines or dots; not set uses a contrasting theme ink.

background.description: Fill behind the pattern; not set uses the region colour.

size.description: Pattern cell in px (3 to 40). Default: `6`, `7` for dots.

width.description: Line width or dot radius in px (0.3 to 10). Default: `1.1`, `1.4` for dots.

angle.description: Rotation in degrees. Default: `45` for hatch, `-45` for hatch-reverse, otherwise `0`.

pattern.description: Pattern drawn over the range's regions.

ranges.description: Explicit value ranges, each with its own colour (and legend entry); win over the scale type.

nullColor.description: Fill of regions without a value; not set uses a light theme grey.

patterns.description:
Adds automatic patterns to every bucket but the first (ranges and quantize scales), for print
and colour-blind readers. Default: `false`.

width.description: Outline width in px. Default: `0.6` (`0.5` on dark themes).

color.description: Outline colour; not set uses the surface colour (none for dots).

minRadius.description: Smallest bubble radius in px. Default: `3`.

maxRadius.description: Largest bubble radius in px. Default: `26`.

radius.description: Hexagon radius in px; `'auto'` uses 1/60 of the map width (5 to 14 px). Default: `'auto'`.

scaleSize.description: Scales each hexagon by its count as well as colouring it. Default: `true`.

colors.description: Colour stops of the count ramp; not set derives three stops from the layer colour.

hexbin.description: Hexbin layers that bin points into hexagons.

curvature.description: Bulge of the arcs relative to their length. Default: `0.28`.

width.description: `[min, max]` stroke width in px, scaled by the square root of the value. Default: `[1, 3.5]`.

flow.description: Animates a moving dash along each arc while animations are on. Default: `true`.

endpoints.description: Draws dots at both ends of each arc. Default: `true`.

size.description: Marker size in px. Default: `24`.

labels.description: Writes the point name next to each marker (a layer or point setting wins). Default: `false`.

width.description: Line width in px (a layer or route setting wins). Default: `2.5`.

geodesic.description: Follows great circles between stops instead of straight lines. Default: `true`.

stops.description: Draws a dot at each stop. Default: `true`.

arrows.description: Adds direction arrows along the route. Default: `true`.

labels.description: Writes the stop names. Default: `false`.

dash.description: SVG dash array of the route line; not set draws it solid.

annotations.description:
Callouts, free text and region notes, placed by `region`, `at: [lon, lat]` or `lon`/`lat`; kept
at screen size while zooming. Default: `[]`.

title.description: Legend title; not set uses the layer name.

legend.description: Colour or size legend under the map.

fit.description:
Framing: `'map'` shows the whole map, `'data'` frames the data, `'auto'` frames point, arc and
route layers but shows the whole map for choropleths. Default: `'auto'`.

enabled.description: Enables zoom and pan of the view. Default: `true`.

wheel.description: Wheel zoom: `'ctrl'` zooms only while Ctrl or Cmd is held, `true` on every wheel event, `false` never. Default: `'ctrl'`.

min.description: Smallest zoom factor. Default: `0.25` for the network, `0.05` for the tree.

max.description: Largest zoom factor. Default: `8` for the network, `3` for the tree.

toRegion.description: A double click on a region zooms to that region (instead of zooming in one step). Default: `true`.

zoom.description: Zoom and pan (scale 1 to 16 by default).

formatter.description:
`(value) => string` for values in tooltips and legend; not set uses `tooltip.y.formatter` or a
compact number.

enabled.description: `false` switches drill-down off. Default: `true`.

breadcrumb.description: Shows the breadcrumb of the opened levels. Default: `true`.

rootLabel.description: Breadcrumb label of the top level; not set uses `'Overview'` (sankey) or the map name.

load.description: load(item, info) returns a level or a Promise of one

drillable.description: ids that can be opened, or a test; default: every item when only load is set

map.description: Map name or TopoJSON / GeoJSON of the level.

label.description: Breadcrumb label of the level; not set uses the region name.

regions.description: Levels per region id: `{ map, series, label, colorScale }`, or `true` to load the level via `load`.

plugins.description: Plugins of this chart: plugin objects, registered names, or `['name', options]`.

gap.description: Gap between columns in px (0 to 12). Default: `2`.

radius.description: Corner radius of the cells in px (0 to 8). Default: `3`.

fill.description:
`'soft'` uses calmer tones of the palette for the large cells, `'solid'` the palette as is (a
series `color` is always kept). Default: `'soft'`.

widths.description: Column widths: `'total'` follows the column totals; an array sets explicit column weights. Default: `'total'`.

sort.description: Column order: data order (`'none'`), or by column width `'asc'` / `'desc'`. Default: `'none'`.

showName.description: Adds the series name to the cell label when it fits. Default: `true`.

showPercent.description: Shows the cell's share of its column; `false` shows the cell value instead. Default: `true`.

minWidth.description: Narrowest cell in px that gets a label. Default: `34`.

minHeight.description: Lowest cell in px that gets a label. Default: `18`.

outside.description: A last column too narrow for its labels gets them in a gutter right of the plot. Default: `true`.

formatter.description: `(share, { seriesIndex, category, value, w }) => string` for the value text of a cell.

showTotal.description: Adds the column total under the name. Default: `true`.

showShare.description: Adds the column's share of the whole under the name. Default: `true`.

wrap.description: Wraps a name that does not fit onto two lines at a word break. Default: `true`.

abbreviate.description: Abbreviates a name that still does not fit (initials; the full name is the hover title). Default: `true`.

abbreviations.description: Own abbreviations per column name, e.g. `{ 'North America': 'NA' }`.

show.description: Shows the legend (with two or more series). Default: `true`.

enabled.description: Turns on the narrative player. Default: `false`.

source.description:
`'frames'` replays the supplied frames; `'record'` records the chart's own data updates.
Default: `'frames'`.

t.description: Time or key of the frame, usable with `seek({ t })`.

series.description: Series of the frame, in the chart's series format.

label.description: Frame label, shown as the watermark.

caption.description: Caption shown and announced when the frame is reached.

options.description: Options applied when the frame is reached (`updateOptions` patch).

annotations.description: Annotations shown while the frame is current.

maxFrames.description: Ring-buffer size of `source: 'record'`; older frames are dropped. Default: `600`.

interpolate.description: Draws in-between values while scrubbing between frames. Default: `true`.

keyBy.description:
Point identity across frames (`'x'` or a function); also used as the morph key of updates
unless the app sets one. Default: `null` (by index).

frameDuration.description: Time per frame during playback, in milliseconds. Default: `800`.

loop.description: Restarts from the first frame after the last. Default: `false`.

autoplay.description: Starts playback on mount, unless reduced motion is preferred. Default: `false`.

transport.description: Draws the transport bar (play, scrubber, live). Default: `true`.

watermark.description:
Large background text of the current frame: `'auto'` (frame label for frames, off for record),
`'label'`, `false` or a function. Default: `'auto'`.

liveBehaviour.description:
New recorded data while viewing an older frame: `'buffer'` stays on that frame behind a Live
button, `'follow'` jumps to the newest. Default: `'buffer'`.

levels.description: Level names, centre first (`['Core', 'Services', …]` or `{ name, description }`); `'auto'` names them Core, Level 1, Level 2 … Default: `'auto'`.

core.description: Node ids of the core when no node has `level: 0`; not set uses the most connected node.

sides.description: Polygon sides; `'auto'` = the group count for 5–12 groups, twice it for 2–4, 6 for one group. Default: `'auto'`.

rotation.description: Turns the shells, degrees; 0 puts a vertex at 12 o'clock. Default: `0`.

sectors.description: Sector size per group: `'equal'`, `'weighted'` (by its most crowded shell) or `'auto'`. Default: `'auto'`.

order.description: `'crossings'` reorders nodes inside a facet (barycentric sweeps) to reduce crossings; `'data'` keeps the data order. Default: `'crossings'`.

coreRadius.description: Level-1 radius as a fraction of the outer radius. Default: `0.24`.

bundle.description: Pull of plain edges towards the centre, 0 (straight) to 1; edges between two facets route through both facets' anchors. Default: `0.65`.

degreeAlpha.description: Fades edges of hubs: opacity × clamp(2 / √(max endpoint degree), 0.35, 1). Default: `true`.

lod.description: Level of detail for cross-facet edges, `'auto'` from 300 nodes: at overview zoom they fade (ribbons stand for them); zoomed in, only those with an end in view are drawn (hover / highlight still show all of a node's links). Default: `'auto'`.

lodZoom.description: Zoom factor from which the individual cross-facet edges come back. Default: `1.8`.

ribbons.description: With lod at overview zoom: one ribbon per facet pair, width by its link count (title: `A – B: n links`). Default: `true`.

edges.description: Plain edge rendering in dense estates.

labels.description: Writes the level name on each shell. Default: `true`.

opacity.description: Outline opacity; `'auto'` follows the theme. Default: `'auto'`.

labels.description: Writes the group names outside the outer shell. Default: `true`.

facets.description: Filled facet sectors, one per group.

show.description: Draws causal edges and paths. Default: `true`.

dash.description: Dash pattern `[dash, gap]` in px. Default: `[6, 5]`.

curvature.description: Sideways bow of a hop (fraction of its length). Default: `0.22`.

arrows.description: Arrow heads at the effect end. Default: `true`.

flow.description: Dashes flow from cause to effect (off under reduced motion). Default: `true`.

colors.description: Colours per severity; not set uses the theme's negative / warning / accent / positive.

title.description: Leads the legend row (e.g. your word for "Levels").

legend.description: Level legend in the legend row above the plot (replaces the group legend; needs `legend.show` of the network too).

plugins.description: Plugins of this chart: plugin objects, registered names, or `['name', options]`.

renderer.description: `'svg'` or `'canvas'`; `'auto'` uses canvas from `canvasThreshold` nodes. Default: `'auto'`.

canvasThreshold.description: Node count above which `renderer: 'auto'` switches to canvas. Default: `1200`.

minRadius.description: Smallest node radius in px. Default: `4`.

maxRadius.description: Largest node radius in px (graphs over 1000 nodes cap it at 8). Default: `16`.

sizeBy.description: Node size from `'value'`, `'degree'` (number of links) or `'none'`; `'auto'` uses value when a node has one, else degree. Default: `'auto'`.

strokeWidth.description: Width of the ring around each node in px. Default: `1.5`.

width.description: `[min, max]` line width in px, scaled by edge weight. Default: `[0.8, 3]`.

opacity.description: Edge opacity; not set uses 0.3 (0.34 in dark mode, 0.16 over 1000 nodes).

bundle.description: Bundles edges between groups through the group centres. Default: `false`.

bundleStrength.description: How tightly bundled edges follow the group centres (0 to 1). Default: `0.85`.

curvature.description: Bend of the edges, 0 straight. Default: `0`.

linkDistance.description: Target edge length; `'auto'` derives it from the node sizes. Default: `'auto'`.

charge.description: Repulsion between nodes; `'auto'` derives it from the node sizes. Default: `'auto'`.

groupStrength.description: Pull of nodes towards their group centre (with two or more groups). Default: `0.1`.

iterations.description: Simulation steps; `'auto'` runs until the layout has cooled down. Default: `'auto'`.

warmup.description: Steps computed before the first paint; `'auto'` uses 40 from 600 nodes and 90 from 2000. Default: `'auto'`.

show.description: `false` treats all nodes as one group: no group colours, clustering or legend. Default: `true`.

hulls.description: Draws a soft rounded hull behind each group (svg renderer, two or more groups). Default: `false`.

groups.description: Node groups (`group` in the node data).

show.description: Shows labels, biggest nodes first, without overlaps. Default: `true`.

max.description: Most labels at the fit zoom (fewer in dense graphs, more when zoomed in). Default: `40`.

minZoom.description: Zoom from which small nodes get labels too. Default: `1.6`.

formatter.description: `(name, { node, w }) => string` for the label text.

mode.description: 'auto' (default where on): nothing for labels off the marks, a contrasting text colour over one fill, a pill over mixed fills; 'hide' = skip labels that sit on marks

fallback.description: what 'auto' escalates to over mixed fills or when no text colour reaches minRatio. Default 'pill'

enabled.description: false switches the treatment off for this label kind

contrast.description: swap the text to `light`/`dark` when it misses minRatio against what is under it (any mode)

minRatio.description: WCAG 2 contrast ratio to reach. Default 4.5

light.description: text/backdrop colour pair used by contrast and 'auto' fills. Defaults '#ffffff' / '#111827'

dark.description: Dark colour of the pair. Default: `'#111827'`.

background.description: colour under the chart; 'auto' = chart.background, else the first opaque ancestor

color.description: Outline colour; 'auto' uses the colour under the label or a contrasting one. Default: `'auto'`.

blur.description: Blur in pixels; above 0 the outline becomes a soft glow. Default: `0`.

halo.description: outline behind the glyphs; blur > 0 makes it a soft glow. Defaults width 3, color 'auto' (chart background), opacity 0.92

fill.description: Box colour; 'auto' uses the colour under the label or a contrasting one. Default: `'auto'`.

padding.description: Space around the text in pixels: one number, or [vertical, horizontal]. Default: `[1, 4]`.

stroke.description: Outline colour of the box. Default: `'none'`.

strokeWidth.description: Outline width in pixels. Default: `1`.

offset.description: Shift of the box as [dx, dy] in pixels. Default: `[0, 0]`.

pill.description: backdrop box. padding = [vertical, horizontal]; offset = [dx, dy] px. Defaults fill 'auto', opacity 0.9, radius 4, padding [1, 4]

dx.description: Horizontal shadow offset in pixels. Default: `0`.

dy.description: Vertical shadow offset in pixels. Default: `1`.

color.description: Shadow colour. Default: `'#000000'`.

shadow.description: drop shadow on the pill (on the text in halo mode)

raise.description: axis labels sitting on marks are moved above the series (default true)

each.description: per label: return an override (or 'none') for this one label; called only when set

readability.description: Facet layout: treatment of labels over facets and shell lines (pill by default; full options with features/readability). Default: `'auto'`.

labels.description: Node labels.

enabled.description: Lets the user drag nodes. Default: `true`.

pin.description: Keeps a dragged node where it was dropped. Default: `false`.

zoom.description: Zoom and pan of the network view.

show.description: Shows the group legend (with two or more groups). Default: `true`.

facet.description:
Facet layout (`layout.type: 'facet'`). Node data may carry `level` (0 = centre), `severity`
(`'critical' | 'warning' | 'info' | 'ok'`), `anomaly` (`true` or a short text), `badge`,
`labelPriority` (`true`: always labelled, like warnings) and `keys`. Label priority (any network
layout): highlighted, then critical, then warning / anomaly / labelPriority – these labels are never
dropped for the label budget or the zoom threshold. Edges `causal: true`; a series `paths: [{ name, nodes, severity, color }]`.

enabled.description:
Toolbar buttons (rotate left / right, reset), the `[` `]` and Home keys and picking a segment
(double-click, Shift+Enter on a focused item). The `chart.orient` API works without it.
Default: `false`; `chart.orient: true` turns it on.

angle.description:
Turn in degrees, clockwise from the default orientation (negative = counter-clockwise).
Set on create or in `updateOptions`; the turn then stays across updates. Default: `0`.

toolbar.description: Rotate-left, rotate-right and reset buttons (the toolbar, or a small bar of their own). Default: `true`.

keyboard.description: `[` / `]` turn by one step, Home resets a turned chart, Shift+Enter turns the focused item to `target`. Default: `true`.

pick.description: Double-click a segment (or Shift+Enter on a focused one) to turn it to `target`. Default: `true`.

step.description:
One step of the buttons, keys and `rotateBy({ steps })` in degrees; `'auto'` = a time window
of whole segments close to 45° (3 h on a 24 h clock, a day on a week). Default: `'auto'`.

target.description: Where a picked segment goes: `'top'`, `'right'`, `'bottom'`, `'left'` or degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock. Default: `'top'`.

name.description: Plugin id (state key and warnings); not set uses `plugin-<index>`.

defaults.description: Default options of the plugin; the `['name', options]` form overrides them.

reserve.description: `(p) => { top, right, bottom, left }`: space in px taken from the plot before layout.

afterRender.description: `(p)`: called after each render; draw into `p.layer()` and bind events with `p.on()`.

event.description:
`(name, e, payload, p)`: called for every chart event; returning `false` cancels a cancelable
one.

tooltip.description: `(content, p) => content`: changes the tooltip content (rows, footer, …).

describe.description: `(p) => string` appended to the screen-reader summary.

destroy.description: `(p)`: called before each redraw and on destroy.

id.description: Lane id; series name it in `lane`.

kind.description: `'events'` columns (counts per slot, colour = error rate), `'heatmap'` one strip per series, `'budget'` error budget left per series (%), `'lines'`, `'stacked'` areas.

title.description: Lane title. Default: the kind's name.

unit.description: Unit of the values, used on the lane, in tooltips, the CSV export and describe(): `'requests / 10 min'`, `'€ / h'`, `'ms'`, `'%'`.

aggregate.description: How the values add up over time in describe() and the a11y items. Default: events `'sum'`, budget `'last'`, others `'mean'`.

color.description: Lane colour (events columns without errorRate, heatmap ramp).

max.description: Upper end of the value axis; not set uses the data.

height.description: Lane height in px; not set shares the free height (events 1, lines 1.25, stacked 1).

plugins.description: Plugins of this chart: plugin objects, registered names, or `['name', options]`.

start.description: First slot: ISO string or ms.

time.description: The slots: slot i covers `start + i × step` to `start + (i + 1) × step`.

markers.description: Deploys (◆) and pipeline runs (●) on the events lane. The deploy within 2 h before the first incident that shares one of its keys is marked as the likely cause.

utc.description: Time labels in UTC (with "UTC" in the export header) or local time. Default: `true`.

errorRate.description: Error-rate classes of the events columns in %: below `warn`, `warn`–`critical`, above. Default: `{ warn: 1, critical: 5 }`.

lens.description:
Focus lens: magnifies the time axis between `from` and `to` (default: the first incident ± max(3 slots, 30 min))
by `factor` relative to the rest of the axis (1.5–12, default 4). Values are never changed. Shown as a header chip
(a button: click or L toggles it), on the axis and in describe(). Default: on for quintConvergence, off for quintTimeline.

focus.description: Incident callouts: one value per lane at the incident, wired to its start. Default: on for quintConvergence.

crosshair.description: Shared crosshair over all lanes. Default: `true`.

legend.description: Legend below the lanes. Default: `{ show: true }`.

plugins.description: Plugins of this chart: plugin objects, registered names, or `['name', options]`.

orientation.description:
`'horizontal'` lets the flow run left to right; `'vertical'` runs it top to bottom. Default:
`'horizontal'`.

nodeWidth.description: Node bar thickness in px. Default: `12`.

nodePadding.description: Gap between nodes of a column in px. Default: `16`.

nodeAlign.description:
Column of nodes without outgoing links: `'justify'` moves them to the last column, `'left'`
keeps them at their depth, `'right'` aligns everything to the end, `'center'` puts sources next
to their first target. Default: `'justify'`.

nodeBorderRadius.description: Corner radius of the node bars in px. Default: `3`.

minNodeHeight.description: Smallest node length in px, so tiny values stay visible. Default: `2`.

iterations.description: Relaxation passes that reduce link crossings (ignored with `sort: 'input'`). Default: `32`.

sort.description:
`'input'` keeps the node order of the data; `'auto'` reorders nodes to reduce crossings.
Default: `'auto'`.

cycles.description:
Data with a cycle: `'error'` shows an error and emits an `error` event, `'break'` drops the
closing links (with a console warning), `'circular'` draws them as return loops. Default:
`'error'`.

color.description: Node colour.

rtl.description:

showValue.description: Shows the node value under the name. Default: `true`.

fontSize.description: Label font size; not set uses the theme font size.

fontWeight.description: Label font weight. Default: `600`.

formatter.description: `(name, { node, value, w }) => string` for the label name.

valueFormatter.description: `(value, { node, w }) => string` for values in labels and tooltips; not set uses `tooltip.y.formatter` or a number format.

labels.description: Node labels.

enabled.description: `false` switches drill-down off. Default: `true`.

breadcrumb.description: Shows the breadcrumb of the opened levels. Default: `true`.

rootLabel.description: Breadcrumb label of the top level; not set uses `'Overview'` (sankey) or the map name.

drillable.description: ids that can be opened, or a test; default: every item when only load is set

date.description: The day shown (YYYY-MM-DD in timeZone; a week starts on its Monday).

items.description: Appointments; start / end as ms, ISO or 'HH:MM' on `date`. `patient` is a pseudonymous id, hidden unless redact: false.

hours.description: Opening hours: closed time and breaks are hatched; appointments outside are a warning.

rules.description: A changeover between two rooms below minTransfer is a warning. Default: `'5min'`.

lanes.description: Lanes per resource or per person. Default: `'resources'`.

routes.description: Draw a route per person. Default: `true`.

snap.description: Snap of drag / keyboard moves in minutes. Default: `15`.

editable.description: Drag / resize / keyboard moves emit 'scheduleChange' proposals (data is never changed). Default: `true`.

redact.description: Keep patient ids out of describe(), tooltips and the table. Default: `true`.

conflicts.description: Conflict summary in the header and the number of listed conflicts. Default: `{ show: true, list: 3 }`.

name.description: Series name shown in the legend and tooltip.

type.description:
Per-series chart type in combo charts; for the map, the layer kind (choropleth, bubble, hexbin,
arcs, markers, pins, routes).

color.description: Colour of the series; overrides the palette colour at its index.

group.description: Stack group: stacked bars with the same group share one stack.

hidden.description: Starts the series hidden, as if toggled off in the legend. Default: `false`.

nodes.description: Graph nodes (network, sankey, tree) when the graph is passed as `data`.

edges.description: Network edges when the graph is passed as `data`.

links.description: Sankey links when the graph is passed as `data`.

data.description:
Data of the series: numbers, `[x, y]` pairs, point objects, or a `{ nodes, edges, links }`
graph, depending on the type.

edges.description: Network edges: `{ from, to }` objects or `[from, to, weight?]` tuples.

links.description: Sankey or network links: `{ from, to, value }` objects or `[from, to, value?]` tuples.

paths.description: Network: highlighted paths, each a node id sequence with a name, severity and colour.

highlightData.description: highlight-filter feature: the filtered part of every point

size.description: Map marker series: marker size in pixels.

labels.description: Map marker series: draws a label next to each marker.

lane.description: quintTimeline / quintConvergence: id of the lane (plotOptions.quint.lanes[].id) this series is drawn in.

keys.description: quintTimeline / quintConvergence: semantic keys (service, cluster, region) for crossfilter across lanes. Default: `[name]`.

errorRate.description: quintTimeline / quintConvergence, events lane: error rate per slot in percent (0–100); colours the columns.

typical.description: quintTimeline / quintConvergence, events lane: the typical day per slot, drawn as a dashed step line.

availability.description: quintTimeline / quintConvergence, budget lane: availability target in percent, shown as "availability · p95 latency".

p95.description: quintTimeline / quintConvergence, budget lane: p95 latency in ms, shown as "availability · p95 latency".

id.description: Id of the drawing; not set gets `'d1'`, `'d2'`, ...

type.description:
`'trendline'` (2 points), `'ray'` (horizontal, 1 point), `'fib'` (retracement, 2 points) or
`'rect'` (2 corners); aliases such as `'line'` or `'box'` are accepted.

points.description: Anchors as `{ t, y }` or `[t, y]` (time, price); invalid drawings are skipped.

color.description: Colour; not set uses `drawings.colors` or the palette.

label.description: Text written along the drawing.

extend.description:
Trend line: extends to the plot edge (`true` or `'both'` both ways, `'left'`, `'right'`); fib:
`false` ends the levels at the second point.

dash.description: `true` dashes the line; a string is used as SVG dash array; not set draws it solid.

fill.description: Fill of a rectangle; not set uses a faint tint of the colour.

locked.description: `true` stops the user from moving or editing the drawing.

labelPosition.description: Side of the trend line label. Default: `'above'`.

plugins.description: Plugins of this chart: plugin objects, registered names, or `['name', options]`.

enabled.description: with chart.type 'candlestick': draw it with the stock renderer

style.description: Price display: candles, OHLC bars, a close line or a close area. Default: `'candlestick'`.

up.description: Rising candle colour; not set uses the theme's positive colour.

down.description: Falling candle colour; not set uses the theme's negative colour.

colors.description: Colours of rising and falling candles.

height.description: Share of the price pane used by volume (0.05 to 0.5). Default: `0.2`.

volume.description: Volume bars at the bottom of the price pane (drawn when the data has volume).

type.description: Overlay kind (`'bb'` is accepted for Bollinger).

k.description: Bollinger band width in standard deviations. Default: `2`.

color.description: Line colour; not set cycles through theme colours.

overlays.description: Price overlays: SMA, EMA or Bollinger bands. Default: `[]`.

type.description: Indicator kind.
Indicator kind.

indicators.description: Indicator panes under the price pane: RSI or MACD. Default: `[]`.

label.description: Button text; also the value of `selected`.

months.description: Months back from the last candle.

days.description: Days back from the last candle.

ytd.description: Spans from 1 January of the last candle's year.

buttons.description: Buttons, each spanning `months`, `days`, the year to date (`ytd`) or `all`. Default: 1M, 3M, 6M, YTD, 1Y, All.

selected.description: Label of the initial range; not set picks 6M (over 400 days of data), 3M (over 120 days) or All.

navigator.description: Overview strip with a draggable window under the chart.

show.description: `false` hides the readout and its reserved space. Default: `true`.

readout.description: OHLC and overlay values written at the top of the price pane.

follow.description: Keeps the view at the newest candle when new ones arrive while the view is at the end. Default: `true`.

enabled.description: `false` disables wheel zoom and drag panning. Default: `true`.

wheel.description: `'ctrl'` zooms while Ctrl or Cmd is held, `true` on every wheel event; other values never. Default: `'ctrl'`.

minCandles.description: Fewest candles in view (at least 2). Default: `8`.

zoom.description: Zoom and pan of the time axis.

decimals.description: Decimals of prices; not set uses 0 from 1000, 2 from 1, otherwise 4.

formatter.description: `(price, { w }) => string` for axis labels and readouts.

type.description: `'log'` uses a logarithmic scale, `'percent'` shows the change against the first visible close. Default: `'linear'`.

timeframe.description: Candle size; `'week'` and `'month'` aggregate the input candles. Default: `'day'`.

label.description: Text chip at the left end of the line.

color.description: Line colour; not set cycles through theme colours.

dash.description: `false` draws the line solid; otherwise it is dashed.

priceLines.description: Horizontal price levels (orders, targets, stops) with an axis label. Default: `[]`.

label.description: One or two characters inside the flag. Default: `'•'`.

text.description: Hover text of the flag (after the date).

color.description: Flag colour; not set cycles through theme colours.

position.description: `'below'` the candle's low or `'above'` its high. Default: `'below'`.

markers.description: Event flags (earnings, dividends, splits) on the candle of their date. Default: `[]`.

enabled.description: Turns the drawing tools on. Default: `false`.

toolbar.description: `false` hides the tool buttons (drawings stay visible). Default: `true`.

magnet.description: Snaps anchors to the open, high, low or close within 10 px of the pointer. Default: `true`.

keepTool.description: Keeps the tool active after a drawing is finished. Default: `false`.

storageKey.description: localStorage key; set saves and restores the drawings.

palette.description:
`'muted'` uses the accent for trend lines and a muted tone for the rest; `'vivid'` gives
every tool its own colour. Default: `'muted'`.

colors.description: Colour per tool; wins over the palette.

fontSize.description: Font size.

fontFamily.description: Font family; not set uses the chart font.

fontWeight.description: Font weight.

colors.description: Text colours; an array gives one per series or item.

fontFamily.description: Chart font family (CSS `--wcc-font-family`).

fontSize.description:
Base font size of labels, legend and tooltip (CSS `--wcc-font-size`); axis labels use one pixel
less, at least 10px.

text.description: Primary text colour: titles and centre values (CSS `--wcc-text`).

textMuted.description: Secondary text colour: axis labels, legend, subtitle (CSS `--wcc-text-muted`).

surface.description:
Colour of surfaces drawn on top of the plot, such as marker outlines and slice separators (CSS
`--wcc-surface`).

background.description: Chart background colour (CSS `--wcc-background`).

grid.description: Grid line colour; also radar polygons (CSS `--wcc-grid`).

axis.description: Axis border, tick and crosshair colour (CSS `--wcc-axis`).

track.description: Background track of radial bars and gauges (CSS `--wcc-track`).

accent.description: Accent colour of hovered and selected menu items (CSS `--wcc-accent`).

focusRing.description: Colour of the keyboard focus indicator (CSS `--wcc-focus-ring`).

tooltipShadow.description: Tooltip box-shadow, any CSS shadow value (CSS `--wcc-tooltip-shadow`).

radiusSm.description: Smaller corner radius of axis tooltips and legend items (CSS `--wcc-radius-sm`).

barRadius.description: Bar corner radius in pixels, applied to the outer end (CSS `--wcc-bar-radius`).

lineWidth.description: Stroke width of line-type series in pixels (CSS `--wcc-line-width`).

gridDash.description: Dash length of grid lines; '0' is solid (CSS `--wcc-grid-dash`).

motionDuration.description: Animation duration in milliseconds (CSS `--wcc-motion-duration`). Preset default: '650'.

palette.description: Series colours (CSS `--wcc-palette` as a comma-separated list).

plugins.description: Plugins of this chart: plugin objects, registered names, or `['name', options]`.

layout.description:
`'tidy'` places parents over their children; `'dendrogram'` puts all leaves on the last level.
Default: `'tidy'`.

orientation.description:
Growth direction; `'radial'` places levels on rings. The aliases `'top-to-bottom'`,
`'bottom-to-top'`, `'left-to-right'` and `'right-to-left'` also set `direction`. Default:
`'vertical'`.

direction.description: `'reverse'` puts the root at the bottom (vertical) or right (horizontal). Default: `'forward'`.

rtl.description:
Mirrored layout (first child on the right, horizontal trees grow leftwards, card text
right-aligned); `'auto'` follows the CSS direction. Default: `'auto'`.

template.description:
`'card'`, `'compact'` or `'dot'`; `'auto'` uses dots for radial trees and dendrograms,
otherwise cards. Default: `'auto'`.

radius.description: Card corner radius in px. Default: `10`.

avatar.description: Shows the avatar circle on cards at least 44 px high. Default: `true`.

dotSize.description: Dot radius of the dot template in px. Default: `5`.

stackLeaves.description:
Stacks the leaf children of a vertical card tree in a column; `'auto'` keeps a plain row when
that fits the plot better, `false` never stacks. Default: `'auto'`.

formatter.description: returns text fields only, never HTML

size.description:
`(data, { node, depth, children }) => { width, height }` sets a node's own card size (a
`size` in the data also works).

autoHeight.description:
Wraps long titles and subtitles (up to `maxLines`) and grows the card to fit. Default:
`false`.

maxLines.description: Most lines of a wrapped text with `autoHeight`. Default: `3`.

label.description: Label of the frame.

color.description: Frame colour.

wrappers.description:
Frames around a node and its visible descendants (cards only, not radial); a node's data
`wrapper: true | { label, color }` also adds one. Default: `[]`.

spacing.description: Gaps of the layout in px.

startAngle.description: Start angle in degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock; not set is fitted to the plot.

stretch.description: `false` keeps a true circle; `'auto'` stretches it (up to 1.45 x) along the plot's long side. Default: `'auto'`.

style.description: `'elbow'`, `'curve'` or `'straight'`; `'auto'` uses curves for dot trees (not dendrograms), otherwise elbows. Default: `'auto'`.

color.description: Link colour; not set uses a muted tone (a branch tint for dot trees).

colorBy.description:
Node tint: one colour per top-level `'branch'`, per `'depth'`, or the accent for `'none'`.
Default: `'branch'`.

enabled.description: Lets the user fold and unfold subtrees. Default: `true`.

initialDepth.description: Folds nodes at this depth and deeper on the first render; not set opens everything (nodes with `collapsed: true` start folded).

enabled.description: Enables zoom and pan of the view. Default: `true`.

wheel.description: Wheel zoom: `'ctrl'` zooms only while Ctrl or Cmd is held, `true` on every wheel event, `false` never. Default: `'ctrl'`.

min.description: Smallest zoom factor. Default: `0.25` for the network, `0.05` for the tree.

max.description: Largest zoom factor. Default: `8` for the network, `3` for the tree.

fitMin.description: Smallest scale of the initial fit; not set uses the scale where the smallest text is `readableFont` px.

fitMax.description: Largest scale of the initial fit. Default: `1.5`.

readableFont.description: Text size in px the initial view keeps readable. Default: `11`.

overviewFont.description: A tree too big for the readable scale still opens whole while its smallest text stays at least this size; `false` starts readable at the root instead. Default: `8`.

zoom.description: Zoom and pan (scale 0.05 to 3 by default).

threshold.description: Below this zoom scale card texts are hidden and cards drawn as plain shapes. Default: `0.42`.

load.description: `(node, { w, id, name, depth }) => children[] | Promise`, called when such a node is first expanded.

loadingText.description: Text of the placeholder while loading. Default: `'Loading…'`.

errorText.description: Text when the load fails (a click retries). Default: `'Could not load · retry'`.

lazy.description: Lazy children for nodes with `hasChildren: true` and no `children`.

showValue.description: Shows the value next to the name. Default: `false`.

offsetX.description: Moves the text horizontally in pixels.

offsetY.description: Moves the text vertically in pixels.

formatter.description: Header text from the name and `{ value, depth, seriesIndex, node, w }`.

style.description: Text and background style (fontSize, fontWeight, fontFamily, color, background, cssClass).

header.description: Header strip of the parent tiles.

borderColor.description: Border colour of the parent tiles.

fillOpacity.description: Fill opacity of the parent tiles.

by.description:
Splits the series into one panel per value of this field (or function result). Ignored when
`row` or `column` is set.

row.description: Field (or function) whose values form the rows of a 2-D grid.

panel.description:
Per-panel option overrides: called with the panel key and `{ index, seriesNames }`, returns
options merged over the host options (grid-owned paths and a different `chart.type` are ignored).

column.description: Field (or function) whose values form the columns of a 2-D grid.

emptyPanels.description:
Empty cells of a 2-D grid: `'placeholder'` draws an empty panel, `'skip'` and `'hide'` leave
them out. Default: `'placeholder'`.

data.description: Tidy rows to facet instead of `series`; `x`, `y` and `seriesBy` name their fields.

x.description: Field of `data` with the x value. Default: `'x'`.

y.description: Field of `data` with the y value. Default: `'y'`.

seriesBy.description: Field of `data` that names the series within a panel.

columns.description: Number of panel columns; `'auto'` fits as many as `minPanelWidth` allows. Default: `'auto'`.

minPanelWidth.description: Smallest panel width in pixels for `columns: 'auto'`. Default: `220`.

gap.description: Space between panels in pixels. Default: `12`.

aspectRatio.description: Panel width divided by height, used when `panelHeight` is not set. Default: `1.6`.

panelHeight.description: Fixed panel height in pixels; not set derives it from `aspectRatio`.

minPanelHeight.description: Smallest panel height in pixels. Default: `80`.

order.description:
Panel order: `'first-seen'`, `'asc'`, `'desc'`, an array of keys or a comparator. Default:
`'first-seen'`.

limit.description: Draws only the first N panels and warns; not set draws all.

virtualize.description: Renders only panels near the viewport; `'auto'` turns it on above 64 panels. Default: `'auto'`.

x.description: `'shared'` or `'independent'` x axis per panel. Default: `'shared'`.

color.description: Colour scale; always shared (other values warn and fall back). Default: `'shared'`.

size.description: Size scale; always shared (other values warn and fall back). Default: `'shared'`.

show.description: Draws a header with the facet value above each panel. Default: `true`.

formatter.description: Returns the header text from the facet key and `{ dimension, index, count }`.

fontSize.description: Font size of the headers.

fontWeight.description: Font weight of the headers.

color.description: Text colour of the headers.

style.description: Text style of the headers; not set uses the theme.

labels.description: `'edges'` labels y on the first column and x on the bottom panel of each column; `'all'` labels every panel; `'none'` hides them. Default: `'edges'`.

legend.description: `'shared'` draws one legend for all panels; `'none'` hides it. Default: `'shared'`.

toolbar.description: `'shared'` draws one toolbar for all panels; `'none'` hides it. Default: `'shared'`.

headerValue.description: Metric shown in each header: `'last'`, `'total'`, `'max'`, `'min'` or a function; not set shows none.

sort.description: Sorts 1-D panels by a metric: `'desc'`, `'asc'` or `{ by, dir }`; the metric is `by`, else `headerValue`, else `'total'`.

sparkline.description: Draws the panels as sparklines, at most 96 px high. Default: `false`.

typeMix.description: Allows different cartesian chart types per panel. Default: `false`.

highlight.description: Hovering or focusing a legend item highlights that series in every panel. Default: `true`.

wcc.description:
West Coast Charts trellis extensions (sort, headerValue and virtualization need
trellis-extras).

fill.description: Places the units inside the outline.

plugins.description: Plugins of this chart: plugin objects, registered names, or `['name', options]`.

time.description: The window: start (ms or ISO), span ('24h', '12h') and slot length ('60min').

now.description: The current time (now hand); later slots are "no data yet".

timeZone.description: IANA zone of the labels. Default: the runtime's zone.

events.description: Event markers on the dial, e.g. medication.

alarms.description: Caller alarm windows (wedges); never computed by the chart.

core.description: Any radialColumn layer from the caller for the centre, e.g. a 'matrix' of the caller's own scores.

demo.description: Marks the chart as demo data (status strip and describe()).

short.description: Short name in the status strip and describe(), e.g. 'HF'.

kind.description: 'columns' = the column ring (median per slot), 'cells' = band cells, 'trace' = line at true times, 'range' = high / low pairs.

aggregate.description: Per-slot aggregation for columns and cells. Default: `'median'`.

bands.description: The caller's threshold bands (no built-in clinical thresholds).

data.description: Measurements: [time, value] or, for 'range', [time, high, low]; time = ms or ISO.

staleAfter.description: After this long the last value is shown as stale: minutes, or a duration such as '4h'.

decimals.description: Decimals at most in labels and tooltips. Default: 1.

color.description: Ring colour; not set uses the palette.

bandsLow.description: 'range': bands for the low value (e.g. diastolic); not set uses `bands`.

gapAfter.description: 'trace' / 'range': a gap longer than this many minutes breaks the line. Default: 3 slots.

min.description: Lower end of the value scale.

max.description: Upper end of the value scale.

enabled.description: Enables zoom and pan of the view. Default: `true`.

wheel.description: Wheel zoom: `'ctrl'` zooms only while Ctrl or Cmd is held, `true` on every wheel event, `false` never. Default: `'ctrl'`.

min.description: Smallest zoom factor. Default: `0.25` for the network, `0.05` for the tree.

max.description: Largest zoom factor. Default: `8` for the network, `3` for the tree.

scope.description: trellis: panel key(s) or a function of the key; the annotation is drawn only on matching panels.

tooltip.description: Tooltip text shown on hover and focus, or a function of the annotation.

id.description:
Identifier added as a CSS class to the drawn elements; also the key for removing the annotation
later.

x.description: Position on the x axis: a category, number or timestamp matching `xaxis.type`. Default: `0`.

x2.description:
End of a band: with x2 set the annotation fills the range from x to x2 instead of drawing a
line. Default: `null`.

strokeDashArray.description: Dash length of the line; 0 draws it solid. Default: `1`.

fillColor.description: Fill colour of the band (used with x2). Default: `'#c2c2c2'`.

borderColor.description: Colour of the line, or the band outline. Default: `'#c2c2c2'`.

opacity.description: Opacity of the band fill (0 to 1). Default: `0.3`.

offsetX.description: Horizontal shift of the line or band in pixels. Default: `0`.

offsetY.description: Vertical shift of the line or band in pixels. Default: `0`.

label.description: Text label attached to the annotation.
